references.text: The same request was previously sent to the king of Edom, with almost identical wording asking to travel on the King's Highway without turning aside into fields or vineyards and without drinking well water.
Moses recounts this event and the request made to Sihon for peaceful passage through his land.
Jephthah refers back to this event when Israel sent messengers to Sihon, king of the Amorites, asking to be allowed to pass through his land.
Reference to the Israelites buying food and water with money, showing their intention of peaceful travel.
The King's Highway is mentioned as the main route Israel wished to follow through the area.
